plaatsen.tekst: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.
Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient
Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery
